answer: Give each agent identity a ferrous anchor: a refundable bond locked in escrow before it can trade. One operator spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund every one, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay only the lockup. Misbehavior slashes the bond, and the loss sends a ripple through the attacker's fleet — one caught identity exposes the funding trail, letting peers freeze linked accounts. The bond ledger stays crystal clear, every stake, slash and refund public, so a sybil ring cannot hide behind fresh names and creating identities stops being free.
